questions.question: How many watts are there in one horsepower?
questions.solution:
Option **1** is correct, i.e. __**746 Watt**__.

 
• **Horsepower** is defined by Scottish engineer **James Watt** in the eighteenth century.
 
• A horsepower is a unit of measurement of power.
 
• Power is defined as the rate of doing work, it is the work done in unit time.
 
• SI unit of power is the **W**att (W).
 
• Another unit of power is horse-power (hp).
 
• 1 hp = 746 W

questions.question: Which of the following eye part is 3D printed by Scientists in 2018?
questions.solution:
Option **4** is correct, i.e. __**Cornea**__.

__
 
• **Cornea**__:

 
 
• The cornea is the **transparent front part** of the eye that covers the iris, pupil, and anterior chamber. 
 
• The cornea refracts light with the anterior chamber and lens.
 
• Scientists have created 3D printed human corneas in order to solve the shortage of eye donors.
 
• This would help millions of blind people gain sights and also prevent corneal blindness because of diseases such as trachoma.
 
• The dimensions of the printed cornea were taken from an actual human cornea to match its shape and size.

questions.question: During Mughal period, the Sanskrit Mahabharata was translated into Persian as:
questions.solution:
Option **2** is correct, i.e. __**Razmnama**__.

__
 
• Razmnama:__

 
 
• In Persian, ‘**Razm**’ means ‘**war**’, and ‘**nama**’ means ‘**tale**’. So, Razmnama means ‘tale of war’.
 
• Great Mughal Emperor Jalal Ud-din Muhammad Akbar, commissioned the Mahabharata to be translated into Persian.
 
• The translation was carried out by **Faizi** (brother of Abu’lFazl) and **Abd al-Qadir Bada’uni** (1540 – 1615).
 
• It was under Akbar regime, that the book of Mahabharat was translated in the Persian language.
